titel: Midterm review of the functioning of the Multiannual Financial Framework 2021-2027
titel_en: Midterm review of the functioning of the Multiannual Financial Framework 2021-2027
samenvatting: At the time of the adoption of the 2021-2027 long term budget (Multiannual Financial Framework) in December 2020, the European Commission undertook to present by the end of 2023 a review of the functioning of the MFF. Since the entry into force of the MFF, unexpected challenges have been putting significant pressure on the EU budget, in particular Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and its consequences.
